text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan and I are walking through
the park when she comes to a sudden
stop and becomes
transfixed by a lady
looking out over the water.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that? No, it can't be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, pardon me. There's simply no way
that—but
then again, the resemblance is
so uncanny...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...It must be her. That lady is a stage actress I saw perform in my youth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I believe she has yet to retire... I
remember
watching her and being
mesmerized by her stage
presence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd see her here of all places...
What a
peculiar feeling. It's as if I'm
reliving my
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... it would be dreadfully rude to
strike up a conversation with her out of
the blue. Especially
considering she's off
the clock at the moment...
choice_data_list: Since you have the chance, why not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you... certain? I would be as polite and respectful as possible, of course...
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I shall allow myself to
become a child
once again... and relive
my memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's rare for Mejiro Ardan to look this
giddy. Watching her talk with the stage
actress from a
distance, I can't help but
smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your patience, Trainer. I
had a
wonderful time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Is something the matter? You
have quite
a bewildered look in your
eye...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh?! G-Goodness, what am I doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I don't know what came over
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Th-that can't be right... I was never the
sort of
child to express my excitement
physically.
choice_data_list: Maybe because it took you back to ...
Maybe because it took you back to ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Unless, no, surely not... Was that
spontaneous
movement just now the first
time I've done it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's taken me by surprise as well. To
think that my
body would move on its
own like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still... perplexing movements aside, it
appears
that reviving distant memories is
a wonderful
thing indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is. Back then, I'd watch these worlds
unfolding
up on the stage and feel my
heart pounding with
excitement...
choice_data_list: ...Try to remember how you felt as...
...Try to think back to how you fe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer, please refrain from teasing
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a child anymore. It's no use
indulging in
such juvenile whims.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a child anymore. It's no use
indulging in
such juvenile whims.
choice_data_list: Maybe it'd be nice to just let you...
You could also say you can only do...
You could also say this is somethi...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Have some fun... Actually, in that sense,
I think it
would be all right...
choice_data_list: Maybe it'd be nice to just let you...
You could also say you can only do...
You could also say this is somethi...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...But if I were to have some fun, I think
I'd be
more comfortable doing so with
some company.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... If you're willing to accompany
me,
Trainer, I believe I'll have myself
some fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. You're really quite good at
skipping,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us relax by letting our inner
doofuses
out for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I can see the logic in that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When put in those terms, this sort
of
behavior does indicate a love for—
choice_data_list: You could say it's proof you've br...
It's proof you've broken out of yo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, this really is rather embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so I come to discover a side to
Mejiro Ardan that takes me by
surprise—and it's one she wasn't
aware
of herself either.
